text: DSH Windows Approval Notify（DSH 桌面插件）：在 Windows 上将 DSH 的审批请求和主会话成功完成事件转成系统 Toast。它监听 approval/request，并以 approval/asked 兜底；仅在 DSH 不处于前台时提醒。通知沿用审批原因或会话标题，忽略子代理及非成功结束状态。插件由常驻 PowerShell 宿主显示通知，异常退出时会尝试恢复。适合将 DSH 放在后台运行、需要留意审批或任务结束的 Windows 用户。需要 Windows 10/11 和系统自带的 powershell.exe。

DSH Windows Approval Notify sends Windows toast alerts for DSH approval requests and completed main sessions. It suppresses alerts while DSH is in the foreground and uses a persistent PowerShell host. For Windows users running DSH in the background; requires Windows 10/11 and powershell.exe.
DSH 在后台等我授权时，能不能弹 Windows 通知提醒？
让 Windows 在 DSH 一轮任务完成后通知我。
我把 DSH 最小化运行，怎么知道它正在等审批？
想在 Windows 桌面收到 DSH 主任务结束的提醒。
Can Windows alert me when a background DSH operation needs approval?
I want a desktop toast when my DSH session finishes successfully.
DSH Windows Approval Notify 的功能「审批请求提醒」：收到 DSH 授权请求时显示 Windows Toast，并在主事件未捕获时使用 approval/asked 事件兜底。通知显示 DSH 提供的原因文本。
DSH Windows Approval Notify 的功能「完成状态提醒」：主会话的 turn/end 原因为 completed 时发送 Windows 通知；子代理会话以及其他结束原因不触发提醒。
DSH Windows Approval Notify 的功能「前台抑制」：通知宿主检查当前窗口标题；标题含 DeepSeek Harness 时跳过 Toast，让用户正在查看 DSH 时不重复弹出提醒。
DSH Windows Approval Notify 的功能「通知宿主恢复」：插件激活时启动常驻 PowerShell 通道；写入待发通知，宿主失败时尝试一次性发送并按退避间隔重启。
DSH Windows Approval Notify 仅在 Windows 上启用通知逻辑，并依赖 powershell.exe；插件在其他平台直接返回。
DSH Windows Approval Notify 在前台窗口标题匹配 DeepSeek Harness 时会抑制提醒；它只通知成功完成的主会话，不提示子代理或其他结束状态。
DSH 的审批弹窗容易被其他窗口挡住，有没有桌面提醒？
Notify me on Windows when a DSH approval is waiting in the background.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Windows 消息通知（DSH 插件）：[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

DSH 需要提权、等待你授权，或一轮任务正常结束时，弹出一条 Windows 通知（显示为 **DeepSeek Harness**）。
只有 **DSH 不是当前前台程序** 时才弹：你正盯着 DSH 界面时不打扰。
插件只做转发：不参与授权决策，不改变审批结果，也不做其它任何事情。
section: Windows 消息通知（DSH 插件）

text:
dsh-windows-approval-notify README · 触发条件：| 触发 | 来源 | 标题 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 有操作请求授权 | `approval/request`（兜底 `approval/asked`） | `DSH 需要提权` |
| 一轮任务正常结束 | `session/event` 的 `turn/end`，且 `reason.kind === 'completed'` | `DSH 任务完成` |

- 只有主会话才会提示任务完成；子代理（`header.parentSession` / `origin: 'subagent'`）的会话不提示。
- `turn/end` 的原因不是 `completed`（中止、报错、被拦截、超长截断等）时不提示，也不把中止说成“完成”。
- 前台抑制对两类通知都生效：前台窗口标题包含 `DeepSeek Harness` 时直接跳过，判定逻辑在 `foreground.ps1`。

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · 实现：- 常驻一个 PowerShell 通知宿主，插件激活即预热；之后每条通知只写一行 JSON。
- PowerShell 侧先读前台窗口标题判断是否前台（Win32 `GetForegroundWindow` + `GetWindowText`），需要真正弹窗时才加载 WinRT Toast API。
- 弹窗延迟：预热后约 5–10ms；进程被回收/被杀时退化为一次性弹窗并退避重启宿主。
- 通知标签：授权 `dshApproval`、完成 `dshTaskDone`，同组 `dshNotify`；同类通知互相替换，不同类各自保留一条。

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · 文案：- 授权正文优先用 DSH 自己的 `displayReason`（优先中文），其次 `reason`；都没有时显示 `<工具名> 正在请求你的授权`。
- 完成正文为 `「<会话标题>」已完成`，没有标题时显示 `当前会话的这一轮任务已完成`。
- 正文最多 220 字符，超出截断。

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · 环境要求：- Windows 10/11，系统通知未关闭。
- `powershell.exe`（Windows 自带）。
- 通知宿主以 `com.deepseek.dsh`（DSH 桌面端的 AppUserModelID）发布，所以通知卡片显示为 DeepSeek Harness。

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · 文件：| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 插件：事件监听 + 通知通道（常驻进程、失败退避重启、一次性兜底） |
| `notify-host.ps1` | 纯 ASCII 的 PowerShell 通知宿主，从 stdin 逐行读取 JSON，按需弹 Toast |
| `foreground.ps1` | 前台窗口标题匹配（判断 DSH 是不是当前主程序） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入 `windows-approval-notify` 行 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件管理器的标题/描述 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · 安装：把本仓库克隆（或解压发布包）到任意目录，在 DSH 里执行：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target = <本目录的绝对路径>
```

例如：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target = D:\plugins\dsh-windows-approval-notify
```

安装后插件行立即生效，无需重启 DSH。卸载：

```text
plugin_manager remove_bundle target = dsh-windows-approval-notify
```

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Why：When a long DSH job runs in the background and one of its operations needs approval, DSH waits for you in its own window — a window that is very likely buried behind others, minimized, or on a screen you're not looking at. A task that should have taken three seconds ends up waiting ten minutes for a click.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Why：This plugin moves "waiting for approval" out of the DSH window and into the Windows notification center: the moment an approval request is raised, a system toast appears (attributed to **DeepSeek Harness**), so you notice it while doing something else entirely.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · What it does, and what it doesn't：| | |
| --- | --- |
| ✅ Does | Listens to DSH approval events and forwards their prompt text as a Windows toast |
| ❌ Doesn't | Decide approvals, alter outcomes, click "Allow" for you, log approval content, or touch the network |

It is a **read-only, one-way notification channel**. Remove it and the DSH approval flow is exactly as it was.
section: What it does, and what it doesn't

text:
dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Features：- **Fast** — a persistent PowerShell notification host is pre-warmed when the plugin activates, so each toast costs 5–10ms. You won't see the DSH dialog first and the toast second.
- **Same wording** — reuses the exact text DSH itself shows, so the two never disagree.
- **No spam** — every approval in a burst reuses one notification tag, so a new toast replaces the old one instead of piling up.
- **No duplicates** — the same request is announced once within a 15-second window, even though two event paths can both see it.
- **Never in the way** — if the host process is killed or crashes it restarts with exponential backoff, falling back to a one-shot spawn so nothing is dropped. The approval flow itself is never affected.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Requirements：- Windows 10 / 11, with system notifications enabled (Do Not Disturb / Focus Assist may swallow them).
- `powershell.exe` (ships with Windows).
- Toasts are published under `com.deepseek.dsh` (the DSH desktop app's AppUserModelID), which is why the card reads **DeepSeek Harness**.

> On non-Windows platforms the plugin silently no-ops.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Install：Clone the repository anywhere:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/dsh-windows-approval-notify.git
```

Then, inside DSH:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target = <absolute path to this directory>
```

For example:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target = G:\DS-test\plugins\dsh-windows-approval-notify
```

The plugin row takes effect immediately — no restart needed.

To uninstall:

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Install：```text
plugin_manager remove_bundle target = @local/dsh-windows-approval-notify
```

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · How it works：Two trigger paths, so nothing is missed and nothing is doubled:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant T as DSH tool call
    participant P as index.js

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · How it works：1. **Primary path** — a `prepend` waterfall hook on `approval/request`, so we read the request (and its `displayReason`) before any other answerer can claim it.
2. **Fallback path** — if another answerer claims the request first, we listen for the persisted `approval/asked` session event and fire 120ms later, giving the richer request a chance to arrive first.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · How it works：Delivery goes through a **persistent PowerShell process**: started and handshaked with `ready` when the plugin activates; afterwards each notification is a single JSON line on stdin. The host parses it, calls the WinRT `ToastNotificationManager` and answers `ok`. Compared with spawning a fresh PowerShell per toast (~270ms startup), this is one to two orders of magnitude faster in practice.
dsh-windows-approval-notify README · How it works：If the host dies, it restarts on a 2s → 30s exponential backoff, and any pending notification is delivered by a one-shot spawn in the meantime.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Notification content：| Element | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Always `DSH 需要提权` |
| Body | `displayReason` (tries `zh` / `zh-CN` / `zh-Hans` / `en`), then `reason`, then `<tool> is requesting your approval` |
| Length | Body capped at 220 characters, truncated with `…` |
| Tag | `Tag = dshApproval`, `Group = dshNotify` (same-tag toasts replace each other) |

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Project layout：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host plugin: event listeners, de-dupe, notification channel (persistent process + backoff restart + one-shot fallback) |
| `notify-host.ps1` | Plain-ASCII PowerShell notification host; reads JSON lines from stdin and raises WinRT toasts |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Injection patch that adds the `windows-approval-notify` row |
| `locale/zh.json`, `locale/en.json` | Title and description shown by the plugin manager |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |
| `package.json` | Package metadata and DSH bundle declaration |

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · FAQ：**No notification at all?**
Check Settings → System → Notifications and make sure "DeepSeek Harness" is allowed; also check Do Not Disturb / Focus Assist. If the entry isn't listed at all, the DSH desktop app hasn't registered its AppUserModelID yet and Windows drops the toast.

**The toast shows up before I see the DSH dialog?**
By design — the notification rides the event stream and can beat DSH's own render. Same content, just sooner.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · FAQ：**Will it spam me?**
No. Each approval request is de-duped by `callId` (falling back to `tool|reason`) for 15 seconds, and same-tag toasts replace each other.

**Several approvals at once?**
Only the last one stays in the notification center. A deliberate trade-off: better to lose one line of history than to bury you in toasts.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · FAQ：**Can I change the wording or add a sound?**
There are no options in this version; wording tracks DSH. To change it, `TITLE` at the top of `index.js` and the toast XML inside `notify-host.ps1` are the only two places to touch.

dsh-windows-approval-notify README · Contributing：Issues and PRs are welcome. Please open an issue before larger changes, especially anything touching how events are observed or how toasts are delivered — those two are the whole basis of the "never interferes with DSH" promise.
